confirm.checkout.explain: Record how the customer pays. After that the bike is picked up.

inkoop.stopheling: I checked the frame number on stopheling.nl

inkoop.vat_margin: Margin scheme (private seller, no VAT on the purchase)

abonnementen.title: Service contracts (abonnementen)
abonnementen.subtitle: Who is due for a service? One message per customer is enough.

rapporten.title: Reports
